verdict.rationale: Kong documents a dedicated streaming capability. It states that models can stream words or tokens back to the client for real-time rendering, and that request streaming runs through the AI Model entity. This sits on top of a documented provider-agnostic API that hides provider-specific details from clients. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that streaming works across every supported provider (the docs say only "most models"), detail on how streaming formats are normalized across providers, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
